payload.purpose_context: Two-track fix mission on the shared post-merge partition surface. Track A (#3942): squash '-X theirs' clobbers driver-uncovered kitty-specs planning files with older lane copies. Track B (#4090 + folded #4091): retrospect and doctor disagree post-merge because the primary-wins guard gates on meta['merged_at'], which has no writer. Shared root-cause: what content is authoritative post-merge, and on which surface.
payload.purpose_tldr: Squash merges must not clobber target-newer kitty-specs, and post-merge readers must agree on mission state.

review.reference: Review passed (architect-alphonso, seam/topology lens). DEVIATION ADJUDICATED SOUND — arguably superior to locked D-A2(a). Recency helper is pure (git reads only), correctly gated on is_primary_artifact_kind (meta.json/status/acceptance excluded — FR-003), 5 unit tests non-vacuous under --runxfail, both-advanced committer-date tiebreak (target-wins-on-tie) sound.
